_comment: Permissions-only template. Copy to settings.local.json (per-user, gitignored). Claude should NEVER modify settings.json automatically — see .claude/rules/permissions.md (after /holycode-pm:setup bootstraps rules into .claude/rules/). NOTE: no hooks block here on purpose — plugin users get the file-size + CHANGELOG hooks automatically via the plugin's hooks/hooks.json (${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}), so a $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/hooks block here would point at scripts that don't exist in the project and error on every Write/Edit/Stop. Standalone (non-plugin) users who copied the repo's hooks/ into their project can add the hooks block manually — see hooks/README.md.
